name: ANSI/IEEE protective earth symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for protective earth, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The protective-earth form identifies a connection serving the documented protective conductor arrangement. Its role must be read with the device terminal designation and the installation's bonding paths, rather than treating all ground-like marks as one signal common.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the connection to the assembly's protective-earth network.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Protective earth differs in purpose from functional earth and from an arbitrary signal reference.
